snippet.title: Flawdread — Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Download:
https://kuraishimi.itch.io/flawdread

Flawdread is a classic-style survival horror game, heavily inspired by Silent Hill and Cry of Fear.

You are Brandon, a guy who suddenly woke up inside this nightmare created by a demon and must face his personal hell as he proceeds into the depths. Fulfill God's will, and you can be whatever you want to be.

Made in Godot 3.6
